title: Supply Chain Security - The Ultimate Guide to Software Composition Analysis (SCA) Tools
description:
Mackenzie breaks down everything you need to know about Software Composition Analysis (SCA) — the essential tool for managing open-source dependencies and securing your software supply chain.

Learn how SCA tools identify vulnerabilities in your open-source components, understand transitive dependencies, and help prioritize real risks through reachability analysis. Mackenzie also demonstrates popular tools like Trivy and Aikido Security, showing how to identify, ignore, and fix vulnerabilities effectively.

If you’ve ever wondered how to keep your dependencies safe from vulnerabilities like Log4j, or how tools automatically create and manage SBOMs (Software Bill of Materials), this guide is for you.

📘 What You’ll Learn:

- How open-source dependencies impact your security posture
- What SCA tools do and how they integrate into your workflow
- How to identify and prioritize real vulnerabilities
- Understanding false positives and reachability
- How modern tools like Aikido Security simplify remediation

🔔 Subscribe for weekly videos on developer security tools — next up: Secrets Detection!

⏱️ Video Chapters

00:00 — Introduction: What is SCA?
00:36 — How Software Composition Analysis Works
02:45 — Real-World Example: Log4j Vulnerability
04:00 — Understanding SBOMs (Software Bill of Materials)
05:45 — How Vulnerabilities Are Tracked (CVEs Explained)
06:45 — Demo: Scanning with Trivy
09:30 — False Positives and Reachability
10:30 — Aikido Security Demo & Fixing Vulnerabilities
